verses.en: God standeth in the congregation of the mighty; he judgeth among the gods.
verses.pt: Deus está na assembléia divina; julga no meio dos deuses:
verses.en_web: God presides in the great assembly. He judges among the gods.
verses.en_bbe: <A Psalm. Of Asaph.> God is in the meeting-place of God; he is judging among the gods.

verses.en: How long will ye judge unjustly, and accept the persons of the wicked? Selah.
verses.pt: Até quando julgareis injustamente, e tereis respeito às pessoas dos ímpios?
verses.en_web: “How long will you judge unjustly, and show partiality to the wicked?” Selah.
verses.en_bbe: How long will you go on judging falsely, having respect for the persons of evil-doers? (Selah.)

verses.en: Defend the poor and fatherless: do justice to the afflicted and needy.
verses.pt: Fazei justiça ao pobre e ao órfão; procedei retamente com o aflito e o desamparado.
verses.en_web: “Defend the weak, the poor, and the fatherless. Maintain the rights of the poor and oppressed.
verses.en_bbe: Give ear to the cause of the poor and the children without fathers; let those who are troubled and in need have their rights.

verses.en: Deliver the poor and needy: rid them out of the hand of the wicked.
verses.pt: Livrai o pobre e o necessitado, livrai-os das mãos dos ímpios.
verses.en_web: Rescue the weak and needy. Deliver them out of the hand of the wicked.”
verses.en_bbe: Be the saviour of the poor and those who have nothing: take them out of the hand of the evil-doers.

verses.en: They know not, neither will they understand; they walk on in darkness: all the foundations of the earth are out of course.
verses.pt: Eles nada sabem, nem entendem; andam vagueando às escuras; abalam-se todos os fundamentos da terra.
verses.en_web: They don’t know, neither do they understand. They walk back and forth in darkness. All the foundations of the earth are shaken.
verses.en_bbe: They have no knowledge or sense; they go about in the dark: all the bases of the earth are moved.

verses.en: I have said, Ye are gods; and all of you are children of the most High.
verses.pt: Eu disse: Vós sois deuses, e filhos do Altíssimo, todos vós.
verses.en_web: I said, “You are gods, all of you are sons of the Most High.
verses.en_bbe: I said, You are gods; all of you are the sons of the Most High:

verses.en: But ye shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.
verses.pt: Todavia, como homens, haveis de morrer e, como qualquer dos príncipes, haveis de cair.
verses.en_web: Nevertheless you shall die like men, and fall like one of the rulers.”
verses.en_bbe: But you will come to death like men, falling like one of the rulers of the earth.

verses.en: Arise, O God, judge the earth: for thou shalt inherit all nations.
verses.pt: Levanta-te, ó Deus, julga a terra; pois a ti pertencem todas as nações.
verses.en_web: Arise, God, judge the earth, for you inherit all of the nations.
verses.en_bbe: Up! O God, come as judge of the earth; for all the nations are your heritage.
